final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM account AS a JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency), frequency_averages AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_account_average FROM account_averages GROUP BY frequency) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.frequency, aa.avg_amount, aa.avg_amount / NULLIF(fa.mean_account_average, 0) AS ratio FROM account_averages AS aa JOIN frequency_averages AS fa ON fa.frequency = aa.frequency ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST, aa.account_id LIMIT 10
